actions.label: Rename an open note
actions.entry: Edit Note title in the header.

actions.label: Flush the current note
actions.entry: Press Ctrl+S in the note.

actions.label: Return to the originating view
actions.entry: Click Back to map or the editor back button.

actions.label: Undo an editor action
actions.entry: Press Ctrl+Z or click Undo.

actions.label: Redo an editor action
actions.entry: Press Ctrl+Shift+Z or click Redo.

actions.label: Split a paragraph at the caret
actions.entry: Press Enter within a paragraph.

actions.label: Apply a heading style
actions.entry: Select a heading from the paragraph style menu.

actions.label: Apply quotation formatting
actions.entry: Select Quote in the paragraph style menu.

actions.label: Toggle bold on the selection
actions.entry: Select text and press Ctrl+B.

actions.label: Toggle italic on the selection
actions.entry: Select text and press Ctrl+I.

actions.label: Change the text color
actions.entry: Select text and open Text color.

actions.label: Attach a URL to selected text
actions.entry: Select a label and press Ctrl+K.

actions.label: Insert a folder link

actions.label: Insert a horizontal rule
actions.entry: Choose Horizontal rule in the style menu or type --- and press Enter.

actions.label: Remove a separator
actions.entry: Focus a horizontal rule and press Delete.

actions.label: Recognize a bulleted list

actions.label: Recognize a numbered list
actions.entry: Type 1) followed by a space at the beginning of a paragraph.

actions.label: Nest a list item
actions.entry: Press Tab in a list item.

actions.label: Outdent a list item
actions.entry: Press Shift+Tab in a nested list item.

actions.label: End a list
actions.entry: Press Enter in an empty top-level item.

actions.label: Create or remove a task checkbox
actions.entry: Click Task in the formatting toolbar.

actions.label: Use a cancellable task
actions.entry: Click Cancellable task and use the cross beside the text.

actions.label: Toggle task completion
actions.entry: With the caret in a task press Ctrl+Enter.

actions.label: Insert an image inline
actions.entry: Click Insert image and choose an image file.

actions.label: Insert code at the caret
actions.entry: Click Insert code block above the note.

actions.label: Insert credentials into a note
actions.entry: Choose Insert logins and passwords in the toolbar.

actions.label: Remove an inserted image
actions.entry: Click Remove block beside the image.

actions.label: Select across paragraphs
actions.entry: Drag from inside one paragraph into the next.

actions.label: Move selected rich text
actions.entry: Drag an existing selection to the insertion caret.

actions.label: Change a code block language
actions.entry: Select a language in the code block header.

actions.label: Indent valid JSON or locate an error
actions.entry: Click Format JSON in a JSON code block.

actions.label: Return from code to prose
actions.entry: Press Ctrl+Enter with the caret inside code.

actions.label: Indent selected code lines
actions.entry: Select code spanning multiple lines and press Tab.

actions.label: Outdent selected code lines
actions.entry: Press Shift+Tab with code lines selected.

actions.label: Copy a code block
actions.entry: Click Copy code beside the language menu.

actions.label: Delete a code block
actions.entry: Click Remove code block in its header.

actions.label: Paste text into a paragraph
actions.entry: Paste clipboard text at the caret.

actions.label: Paste formatted text
actions.entry: Paste rich text with paragraphs or inline emphasis into a note.

actions.label: Open local replacement
actions.entry: Press Ctrl+H or expand the replace row.

actions.label: Use case-sensitive find
actions.entry: Click Match case in Find.

actions.label: Find complete words

actions.label: Interpret a regular expression

actions.label: Preserve the matched capitalization

actions.label: Visit the next search match

actions.label: Visit the previous search match

actions.label: Replace one occurrence
actions.entry: Click Replace match or press Enter in Replace with.

actions.label: Replace every in-scope occurrence
actions.entry: Click Replace all.

actions.label: Recall a preceding local query
actions.entry: Press ArrowUp in the Find field.

actions.label: Return to the match in the editor

actions.label: Create a credential row
actions.entry: Click Add entry on the credentials block.

actions.label: Filter credential rows

steps: Rename the open note and apply Quote to its middle paragraph.
Save, return to the library and reopen it.
scenarios.expected: The new sidebar title, quotation and surrounding ordinary paragraphs survive reopening.

steps: Select the middle word and apply bold, italic and a palette color. Select a different word and attach a URL with Ctrl+K.
Reopen the note and inspect all runs.
scenarios.expected: The styled word retains all three marks, the separate label links to the intended URL and the neighbouring text stays plain.

steps: Type 1) and a space, add a second item with Enter, then toggle Task on the second line.
Undo the conversion.
scenarios.expected: Both list markers increment, only the second line becomes a checkbox, and undo recovers its prior numbering and text.

steps: Select inline text and convert it to a code block. Replace the code with two lines and click Copy code.
Paste the captured plain text between characters in another paragraph and undo the paste. This chain supplies an in-memory clipboard.
scenarios.expected: Copy delivers both code lines verbatim. Paste retains their soft line break at the caret and one undo restores the destination paragraph, leaving the code untouched.

steps: With two named images between paragraphs, click Remove block on the second image.
Undo and reopen.
scenarios.expected: Only the chosen image disappears. Undo and reopen preserve both names, their order and both paragraphs.

steps: Select a span across three paragraphs, including a bold middle paragraph. Drag it into the middle of a word in the fourth paragraph.
Undo, redo and reopen.
scenarios.expected: The insertion caret appears before release. Text moves exactly once, the destination splits at that character, bold survives and one undo restores all four paragraphs.

steps: Change a plain data note to CSV. Use Go to line to insert a marker on the third line.
Open the replace panel with its keyboard shortcut, replace two matches, undo and reopen.
scenarios.expected: The marker lands on the requested line, replacement reaches both exact matches, undo restores the previous lines and CSV remains selected after reopening.

steps: Start an ascending line sort, with its first worker request held pending by the test. Click Cancel and release the request.
Retry the same sort normally and undo.
scenarios.expected: Cancellation is acknowledged and retains the original data. A new worker sorts the lines successfully and undo restores the original order.

steps: Open a CSV wider and taller than the viewport. Move from the first cell to the last row and column with Ctrl+Arrow and copy a field longer than its preview into the in-memory clipboard.
Navigate to the opposite corner and copy again.
scenarios.expected: The lower-right value includes its original newline, comma and text past the visible ellipsis. The second copy returns the first data cell without its header.

steps: Open a note with one rich paragraph "item-12" and a JSON code block containing "item-34".
Enable regex, find item-(\d+) and replace all with ref:$1.
Close find, undo once and inspect both blocks.
scenarios.expected: Both exact numbers survive replacement; a single undo restores the original rich text and code.

steps: Open Find and enter an unclosed parenthesis in regex mode.
Check invalid feedback; then correct it to cat and advance.
scenarios.expected: The invalid query disables navigation. The corrected query returns two matches and enables Next.

steps: Search for "cat" in "CAT cat catfish".
Toggle whole word, then case sensitivity; turn case sensitivity off and navigate forward then back.
scenarios.expected: The counts progress from three to two to one. After navigation the original match is active again.

steps: Find "cat" in "CAT cat Cat" with "dog" as replacement and Preserve case enabled.
Replace the first result, then replace all remaining results; undo the second operation.
scenarios.expected: The results read "DOG dog Dog", and undoing Replace all keeps the prior single "DOG" change.

steps: Find "alpha", navigate, then search "beta" and navigate.
Recall the earlier query with ArrowUp. Close the note and open a different note.
scenarios.expected: The earlier query can be recalled in this note. The other note opens Find with an empty query.

steps: Select only the last word in "fox fox" and enable Find in selection.
Type "fox " before the original sentence while the panel is open. Replace fox with cat in the selection.
scenarios.expected: The text becomes "fox fox cat"; the other two occurrences stay intact.

steps: Open a note with compact nested JSON and adjacent prose.
Format the JSON, undo, redo, return to the map and reopen.
scenarios.expected: Undo restores the exact compact text. Redo and reopen retain the line breaks and values. The neighbouring prose is unchanged.

steps: Set a code block containing invalid JSON to JSON.
Click Format JSON twice and inspect the text, focus and status.
scenarios.expected: The original invalid text is preserved. The status reports the error line and column and the caret stays in the code field.

steps: Select the complete two-line source in a code block.
Press Tab, then Shift+Tab. Press Ctrl+Enter and type in the following paragraph.
scenarios.expected: Both lines gain indentation and then return exactly to their original content; further typing changes only the paragraph.

steps: Remove a code block between two paragraphs using its own header.
Undo, close the note and reopen it.
scenarios.expected: The neighbouring paragraphs survive removal. Undo and reopen restore the one code block, language and source in its original position.

steps: Convert an existing paragraph to a cancellable task.
Mark it complete with Ctrl+Enter, cancel it using the cross, undo and redo.
scenarios.expected: The cross and check are mutually exclusive; undo restores completion, redo restores cancellation, and the task label stays the same.

steps: Start an empty paragraph with "- " and type a parent.
Start another item, nest it, type a child, outdent, then press Enter twice.
scenarios.expected: Parent and child retain their text. The last empty paragraph has no list marker or indent.

steps: Insert a horizontal rule at the end of the first paragraph.
Focus the rule and delete it, then undo.
scenarios.expected: Exactly one rule returns between the same paragraphs. Their texts are unchanged.

steps: In a data note with header, item10, item2 and footer, keyboard-select just the two middle lines.
Choose Lines > Sort ascending, then undo.
scenarios.expected: The header and footer stay in place; item2 precedes item10. One undo recovers the original document.

steps: Open a data note with whitespace, duplicate values and a blank line.
Trim the lines, remove blanks, remove duplicates, then undo the last command.
scenarios.expected: The final values keep their first original order; undo restores the duplicate without restoring removed whitespace.

steps: Open a CSV with id,region,label and records sharing an id across regions.
Compare duplicates by id and region together, then remove duplicates.
Inspect source text and undo once.
scenarios.expected: Only the second record with the same id AND region is removed. The header, first occurrence, other regions and original row order survive undo.

steps: Open a CSV with a quoted comma and a quoted multiline description.
Sort on its numeric id, switch to Text, check full values, then undo.
scenarios.expected: The entire records move together, including the quoted multiline field. Undo recovers the original order and text.

steps: Open a TSV with data in its first row and turn off First row contains headers.
Close and reopen the note, switch to Table, then open a first-row cell in Text.
scenarios.expected: The header choice is remembered. The first row is accessible as data and navigating to its cell opens the correct source text.

steps: Open malformed CSV containing an unterminated quote as Table.
Read the parser feedback, return to Text and check the original source.
scenarios.expected: The grid reports a quote/record error; the source text including its unfinished quote is retained.

steps: Move the caret between two sentinel words in a data note.
Insert a UTF-16LE file with a BOM that contains Cyrillic text, then undo.
scenarios.expected: The decoded characters appear at the caret with both sentinels preserved. Undo recovers the original source.

steps: Select across two paragraphs and deliver HTML and plain clipboard formats to the note editor. The browser test uses an in-memory paste event.
Apply Heading to the second pasted paragraph; undo that style, then undo the paste. Repeat with the selection dragged backwards.
scenarios.expected: Two independently editable paragraphs replace the selection with bold and italic intact. Applying Heading to the second leaves the first unchanged. Undo the style, then one undo restores the original paragraphs. The OS clipboard is outside this browser check.

scenarios.requires: Requires Windows WebView2 and a Windows clipboard reader.
steps: Add three synthetic credentials to a password-protected note. Filter for the third login and remove its entry.

Filter for the second login, reveal and hide its password, then copy the pair. Edit the private paragraph, close and unlock the note, then undo. Deliver a session-lock event, unlock again and redo. Close the note and search for the password.
Restart and unlock the note. Verify the surviving entries, copy the filtered pair through the desktop app and read it with the Windows clipboard API.
scenarios.expected: Undo and redo work after unlocking in the same process. A process restart preserves the final text and both credentials with empty history. Locked secrets are absent from the library search and the stored public note. The Windows clipboard contains precisely the selected login:password.

scenarios.requires: Requires the Windows folder picker and Explorer.
steps: Select words in the middle of a paragraph. Attach a temporary directory with spaces and a Unicode character using the native folder picker.
Press Ctrl+S, return to the map, reopen the note and click the saved link. Inspect the Explorer folder view.
scenarios.expected: The original label and surrounding sentence survive reopening. Explorer displays the exact chosen path and its unique marker file.

steps: Place the caret between L and R in the same paragraph.
Choose two different PNG files together in the image picker, undo once and redo.
Leave the note and reopen it from the sidebar.
scenarios.expected: Both images appear in picker order between the letters. One undo restores the original single paragraph, and redo and reopen retain both image names and original neighbours.

steps: Open a data note containing sentinel text and place the caret mid-line.
Insert a file containing invalid UTF-8 bytes and no BOM.
After the decoding error, type a marker in the original data note.
scenarios.expected: The editor reports the encoding problem, retains all original text and accepts further input.
